candidates.title: DART: Diffusion-Inspired Speculative Decoding for Fast LLM Inference
candidates.reason: Parallel masked-position drafting removes autoregressive draft rollouts and combines this with efficient tree pruning; reports 2.03x-3.44x wall-clock speedups and directly targets speculative-decoding system overhead.

candidates.title: SpecFed: Accelerating Federated LLM Inference with Speculative Decoding and Compressed Transmission
candidates.reason: Combines speculative decoding with top-K compressed probability transmission for distributed/federated inference, addressing communication as an inference-system bottleneck with theoretical and empirical evaluation.

candidates.title: Accelerating LLM Inference with Lossless Speculative Decoding Algorithms for Heterogeneous Vocabularies
candidates.reason: Removes the shared-vocabulary restriction between draft and target models while preserving the target distribution, broadening practical drafter selection without retraining.

candidates.title: Minions: Accelerating Large Language Model Inference with Aggregated Speculative Execution
candidates.reason: Inference system using multiple speculative models, adaptive speculation length, and pipelined decoupling of drafting and verification to improve throughput and latency.

candidates.title: Decoding Speculative Decoding
candidates.reason: Large empirical study of speculative-decoding performance factors followed by hardware-efficient draft-model design; directly useful for system-level drafter selection and throughput optimization.

discovery_stats.query_summary: Independent speculative-decoding axis spanning parallel drafting, federated inference, heterogeneous vocabularies, aggregated speculation, and empirical system design; exact monthly identity snapshots used to remove represented papers before evaluation.
